contract: reconcile(current, desired) takes two dictionaries with string keys and integer values. Return a deterministic list of actions: ['delete', key] for current keys absent in desired, then ['set', key, value] for new or changed values. Sort each group by key. Omit unchanged entries and preserve both inputs. Empty inputs give []. Return only Python source, no imports.

requirements.description: Delete missing keys before setting changed keys
Preserve unchanged entries and empty inputs
Sort actions and preserve original dictionaries
